The '''Eyar City Sewer''' was an extensive sewer system serving [[Eyar City]]. The city employed [[Eyar Treatment Systems]] to clean, maintain, and treat the sewer system but the company was overworked and underpaid. The sewers for the important and affluent areas of the [[City/Legends|city]] were kept in good repair, but areas such as the [[Southcentral Branch]] under the most densely built area were poorly maintained and parts of the network had to fail before maintenance crews attended.<ref name="HS" />
